author: Tynvale
body:
I think that it would be really nice to add a direct messaging system!

If it was added then people would stop:
- Having random conversations to each other in someone else's topic that has nothing to do with what they are talking about.
- Not having to make topics that apply to only one person

I would like to see what other people's opinions on this, so post any thoughts that you have on this suggestion.
